title: LuxEmo: Expressive Text-to-Speech Corpus for Luxembourgish
title_zh: LuxEmo：面向 Luxembourgish 的表达性文本到语音语料库
abstract_en: State-of-the-art speech datasets predominantly focus on widely spoken languages, often overlooking low-resource languages such as Luxembourgish, which remain underrepresented in speech technology research. In this work, we introduce LuxEmo, a 21-hour conversational expressive speech corpus for Luxembourgish with 4 emotion categories. LuxEmo is derived from Radio Télévision Luxembourg (RTL) youth broadcasts, using automated detection followed by human validation. We propose a semi-automatic curation workflow combining voice activity detection, denoising, language identification, LuxASR-based segmentation, automatic emotion prediction, lexical cues, and targeted human review. Additionally, we benchmark five expressive TTS systems covering German-based cross-lingual transfer, multilingual Luxembourgish support, Luxembourgish adaptation, and non-parametric prosody transfer. Performance is evaluated using both objective metrics and human evaluation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 LuxEmo，一个面向低资源语言 Luxembourgish 的 21 小时对话式表达性语音语料库，包含 4 类情感标签。该语料来自 Radio Télévision Luxembourg（RTL）青年广播，通过自动检测与人工验证构建。作者设计了一套半自动清洗与标注流程，结合 voice activity detection、denoising、language identification、基于 LuxASR 的分段、自动情感预测、词汇线索以及有针对性的人工复核。此外，论文基准评测了 5 类 expressive TTS 系统，涵盖基于 German 的跨语言迁移、多语言 Luxembourgish 支持、Luxembourgish 适配以及非参数化 prosody transfer，并使用客观指标和人工评测进行综合比较。
key_points_zh: 发布 LuxEmo：一个 21 小时 Luxembourgish 对话式表达性语音语料库，覆盖 4 类情感，缓解该低资源语言在语音技术中的数据稀缺问题。
语料来源于 RTL 青年广播，采用自动化筛选后人工验证的方式，兼顾规模、质量与情感标注可靠性。
提出半自动语料构建流程，整合 VAD、降噪、语言识别、LuxASR 分段、自动情感预测、词汇线索和定向人工审核。
评测 5 种 expressive TTS 方案，包括 German-based cross-lingual transfer、多语言模型、Luxembourgish adaptation 与 non-parametric prosody transfer。
通过客观指标和人工主观评测分析不同 TTS 路线在 Luxembourgish 表达性语音合成上的表现。

llm_assessment.comment: A valuable low-resource expressive TTS corpus, but it is largely outside the realtime multimodal-agent and tool-interaction focus.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个有价值的低资源情感TTS语料库，但整体上偏离实时多模态智能体和工具交互方向。
